officialScope.versionEvidence: Revision history lists v1.0 dated August 28, 2026 and v1.1 dated October 29, 2026. The current guide has a latest version URL. Domain pages and service reference pages were retrieved on November 19, 2026 UTC.
officialScope.serviceListCaveat: The current in-scope and out-of-scope pages both call their lists non-exhaustive and subject to change. Revision history v1.1 removes Elastic Transcoder from in-scope and removes DeepComposer, DevOps Guru, Elastic Inference, Managed Blockchain, and Sumerian from out-of-scope. Their removal from the out-of-scope list does not itself prove inclusion in scope because the in-scope list is non-exhaustive and does not establish their presence. Do not treat any of those five as newly in-scope without an explicit official confirmation.
